content: We need number of aromatic carbons in the sample's molecule. We have no description of molecule. We can get carbon NMR spectra to infer aromatic carbons? Could also get HSQC. But maybe easier: get carbon NMR and count signals in aromatic region (~110-160 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then count number of distinct aromatic carbon signals. That likely equals number of aromatic carbons (assuming symmetry may reduce). But question likely expects count of aromatic carbons present in molecule, not distinct signals. Could infer from spectrum peaks count in aromatic region. Use carbon_nmr_spectra.
